svg.title: Swarm Dynamics Lab: system architecture
svg.desc: 3 researchers steer 161 agents. The agents share no orchestrator and send each other no messages: they read and write one git repository, which holds the task board of 290 tasks, inboxes, agent status files and the research record in five numbered folders. A CI verifier checks every push. Amber marks the gates between surveys, hypotheses and experiments. Below, the experiment plane: pre-run admission, an exclusive server claim, workers on short-lived servers, a run hub with a leased run queue, model APIs under a budget ledger and a public live run site.
